binning.method: nearest-rank empirical quintiles of training candidate scores

normalization: Per target, add one logit intercept shared by all 45 probabilities until their sum equals exactly six.

random_comparator.method: 120 uniform random permutations of the 45 calibrated probabilities per target; outcome and probability multiset held fixed

uniform_baseline: Exact Bernoulli marginal inclusion probability 6/45 for each of 45 numbers.

inference.bootstrap: two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap; 50-target blocks; 4000 replicates
